user.title: Connect to EarnApp
user.description:
How to find your cookie keys:
1. Open earnapp.com/dashboard in your browser and log in.
2. Press F12 (Inspect) → go to Application (Chrome/Edge) or Storage (Firefox) → Cookies → https://earnapp.com.
3. Copy the Value of 'oauth-refresh-token' (starts with 1%2F%2F...) and 'xsrf-token'.
4. Do NOT log out after copying, just close the tab.
